title: Design tab and design documents
summary: Adds REQ-0054 (design/*.md format with a 'realises' list) and REQ-0055 (read-only Design tab), STORY-0015 under EPIC-0007 with 3 tasks and 2 evals, including a task to commit the 5 reverse-engineered design specs.
rationale: The app has no design artifacts. Decisions: specs are Markdown files in the requirements repo, versioned in git, each listing the REQ ids it realises; they cover architecture, data model, API contracts, UI flows, and agent integration/security. The specs were drafted from code on 2026-10-03.

data.title: Design document format
data.statement: The system shall read design documents from design/<slug>.md files in the requirements repository, each with front matter giving a title and the list of requirement ids it realises.
data.rationale: Design specs need to be versioned and reviewed like records and traced to the requirements they realise, without a new record kind.

acceptance_criteria.text: A design document is a file design/<slug>.md where slug matches ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,63}$, with front matter fields title (string) and realises (list of REQ ids)
Lint reports an error naming the file and id for every realises entry that is not an existing requirement id
Design documents are served read-only by slug; a slug that does not match the pattern returns 400 and 0 files outside design/ are read

data.title: Design tab
data.statement: The system shall provide a Design tab that lists the project's design documents and renders the selected document as Markdown with its realised requirements linked.
data.rationale: Gives product owners and developers one place in the UI to read how the system is built and which requirements each part realises.

acceptance_criteria.text: The Design tab lists every design document by title, sorted by slug, and shows an empty state with the expected design/ path when there are none
The selected document renders GitHub-flavoured Markdown, including tables and code blocks
Each document shows its realises list, and every REQ-, STORY- or TASK- id in the list or body opens that record in the drawer in 1 click
The Links & impact tab of a requirement lists the design documents that realise it

ops.reason: Design tab belongs to the web UI epic

data.title: Design tab and drawer links
data.description: Design tab in the header nav with a document list and Markdown viewer; linkified record ids; design documents section in the requirement drawer's Links & impact tab; help guide section for the tab.

stories: New STORY-0015 (web, 5 points) under EPIC-0007. No existing story changes scope.
code: Server: new design-document endpoints in server/src/api.rs, a reader module, a lint rule in server/src/lint.rs, and realising docs added to record context (server/src/changes.rs).
Web: new Design tab in web/src/components/Header.tsx, a view in web/src/views/, and a section in web/src/components/RecordDrawer.tsx. The help guides (web/src/components/help) need a Design section.
New tests: design_docs in server/tests/integration.rs and web/e2e/suites/design.js, registered in web/e2e/run.mjs.
risks: The design docs are written outside changesets (git/PR), so the chat agent can't edit them; TASK-0033 is the hand-off.
The specs describe code as of 2026-10-03 and go stale unless updated when code changes; the realises lint rule only catches deleted requirement ids.
